# What is proven on each board

**H** ran on a real board and was seen working · **B** a real build of a program using it succeeded · **-** generated by the compiler but never built for that board · **L** the language names it but this board has no backend · *(blank)* the board doesn't have it. Only the build matrix writes B and only a real board run writes H; a program needing something below B gets warning W618. `mujard boards caps <board>` shows one board with the evidence.

| Capability | What it is |
|---|---|
| `output` | digital outputs (pin N as output) |
| `input` | digital inputs and their events (pressed, changed...) |
| `pwm` | PWM outputs (pin N as pwm) |
| `analog` | analog inputs (analog A0) |
| `fast` | fast pin events (interrupts) |
| `tone` | tone and melody |
| `servo` | servo motors (mujard.servo) |
| `ultrasonic` | ultrasonic distance sensors (mujard.ultrasonic) |
| `uart` | extra serial ports (mujard.uart) |
| `i2c` | I2C (mujard.i2c) |
| `spi` | SPI (mujard.spi) |
| `shift` | shift registers (mujard.shift) |
| `store` | saved values and store.save/load (EEPROM or flash) |
| `rtc` | a real-time clock chip (mujard.rtc) |
| `regs` | register access (mujard.regs) |
| `wifi` | Wi-Fi |
| `clock` | the clock, at HH:MM |
| `http` | HTTP and HTTPS requests |
| `mqtt` | MQTT (mujard.mqtt) |
| `multicore` | more than one CPU core (blocks can run `on core N`) |
| `dma` | a general-purpose DMA engine (the DMA API isn't built) |
| `timers` | hardware timer units (Timer objects) |
| `can` | a CAN/TWAI controller (mujard.can) |
| `bluetooth` | a Bluetooth/BLE radio (mujard.ble) |
| `usb_device` | a native USB-device peripheral (mujard.usb) |
| `rtos` | an RTOS runtime (ESP32 targets run FreeRTOS; Mujard doesn't schedule through it) |
| `ethernet` | an on-chip Ethernet MAC (mujard.ethernet) |

Not in Mujard yet (so not in this table): DMA, displays as built-ins.
